items.docs: Generates a pre-signed S3 URL for uploading a supporting document for an incorporation request. The response includes a document ID and an upload URL that is valid for one minute. Upload the file directly to the pre-signed URL using an HTTP PUT request, then call the upload-complete endpoint with the document ID to notify Vistra the upload has finished.

params.name: id
params.description: The document ID returned by the generate-upload-url endpoint

items.docs: Notifies Vistra that a document upload to the pre-signed S3 URL has completed successfully. This endpoint must be called after the file has been uploaded directly to the pre-signed URL. The response confirms the document ID and returns file metadata including filename and size. The document ID is then used when submitting the incorporation request.
